//: HARD-RULE FIXTURES — spec §6 'Rules and use cases', gate: 100% pass. These are NOT the gold set and must never be merged into it. A gold set measures ACCURACY and therefore needs labels a human chose; these measure ADHERENCE to rules the registry already states, so the expected answer is derivable from config/registry/icp_registry.json and authoring them here is legitimate. Scoring accuracy against fixtures I wrote myself would be grading my own homework.
//companies: The COMPANIES are real, deliberately. A gated ICP needs confirmable evidence, so an example.com lead would fail closed for want of research rather than because the rule fired — the fixture would pass for the wrong reason and prove nothing. The PEOPLE are synthetic (role@domain): the row tests a company gate and a role gate, not a person.
//failures: A failure here does not automatically mean the classifier is wrong. It may mean the expectation is wrong, or that the company changed. Read the reasoning before changing code.
